terms.gloss: put up for all to see: post
evidence: Cic. Att. 8.9.2: in pūblicō epistulam (sc. prōpōnere; Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Our choice: no reference work has a word for posting online. Classically prōpōnere is to put a notice up in a public place for people to read, as Cicero complains that a letter of his was put up in public (Att. 8.9.2), so the sense needs no stretching.

phrases.latin: ī, puer, et citus haec aliquā prōpōne columnā
phrases.english: go, boy, and quickly post this up on some column

sources: No source has a word for posting online.
